frozen_laws.RECOVERY_IS_NOT_REWIND: Recovery may follow a different state path and need not restore the historical microstate.
frozen_laws.FIRST_BREAK_IS_A_BRANCHPOINT_NOT_AN_ENDP: The first detectable break is a candidate branching boundary, not the final biological interpretation.
frozen_laws.OBSERVABLE_RECOVERY_IS_NOT_FULL_STATE_RE: Observable restoration does not establish complete latent-state restoration.
frozen_laws.OBSERVABLE_IS_NOT_STATE: Observed channels are projections and cannot uniquely identify latent state without binding evidence.
frozen_laws.RECOVERY_RESTORES_ALLOWED_FUTURE_NOT_NEC: Recovery is admissible when correctness-relevant successor possibilities are restored under the declared interface.
frozen_laws.EARLIEST_FUTURE_CHANGING_TRANSITION: Search for the earliest transition that changes the set or distribution of correctness-relevant future continuations.

first_future_break.warning: Operational estimation from data may be interval-censored and representation-dependent; do not claim exact physical transition time unless directly supported.

cross_domain_transfer.regeneration: bulk growth != first cell-cycle entry; marker loss != cell clearance; recovery contains multiple non-interchangeable clocks; fate routing matters more than one marker half-life.
cross_domain_transfer.viral: motion/regime break != attachment != entry/uncoating != productive outcome; non-detection != extinction; local first-break state must be evaluated against future branch fate and aggregate baselines.
cross_domain_transfer.shared_invariant: late observable outcomes must not be collapsed onto early hidden transitions without explicit evidence binding.

validation_contract.primary_test: Does local state around the frozen FIRST_FUTURE_BREAK add out-of-sample information about later fate beyond whole-trajectory aggregates?
validation_contract.authority: independent replay and held-out outcome only

next: Run C030 unchanged against public raw single-virus/phage trajectory data; preserve FAIL/UNKNOWN and never retarget FIRST_FUTURE_BREAK after unblinding.
